Docs.param: The representing the table containing the vector column to query.
A selector for the vector property on the entity.
The vector used for search, either a parameter or another vector column.

The distance metric used to calculate the distance between the query vector and the vectors in the specified column. An ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) index is used only if a matching ANN index, with the same metric and on the same column, is found. If there are no compatible ANN indexes, a warning is raised and the KNN (k-Nearest Neighbor) algorithm is used.
Docs.summary: Search for vectors similar to a given query vector using the SQL Server VECTOR_SEARCH() function.

remarks.para: Use after Take(...) to enable approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search, which uses the vector index for better performance. Without WithApproximate, an exact k-nearest neighbor (kNN) search is performed. Add an explicit OrderBy to control result ordering.

<Extension()> Public Function WithApproximate(Of T) (source As IQueryable(Of T)) As IQueryable(Of T)

Docs.summary: Enables approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search for a vector search query. This causes WITH APPROXIMATE to be added to the SQL TOP clause, instructing SQL Server to use the vector index for better performance.

remarks.para: This method must be called after Take(...) to specify the number of results. Without WithApproximate, vector search performs an exact k-nearest neighbor (kNN) search without using the vector index.
